answer: A grove registry admits an agent only after it burns a non-refundable entry fee. Its willow schedule rises with the join rate: 10 credits when quiet, up to 90 after 100 hourly joins. The kth fake thus pays more than the first, and 1,000 fakes burn over 50,000 credits, destroyed never reused. An honest newcomer pays once, keeps its full share, and its burn is etched in a shale record; fee farming fails because the window spans a full epoch.
